changelog: Redesigned the Episodes experience with faster navigation and quick resume functionality.
Improved media browsing performance with smoother scrolling and faster rendering across large content collections.
Improved performance and responsiveness on mobile devices, especially when browsing large media collections.
Added Quick Navigation with new Watch Later, Watching Now, and Hated lists.
Added a new News experience for viewing detailed upcoming and on-air content.
Improved animations, navigation, and overall responsiveness across the application.

features.title: What's New
items: Introduced a redesigned Episodes experience with improved episode cards and navigation.
Added quick resume functionality to instantly return to the last watched episode.
Added Quick Navigation for faster access to your lists and collections.
Added Watch Later, Watching Now, and Hated lists.
Added a new News modal for viewing detailed upcoming and on-air content.
Improved keyboard shortcuts for faster navigation throughout the application.

features.title: Faster & Smoother
items: Significantly improved media grid performance when browsing large collections.
Improved scrolling performance and reduced unnecessary rendering.
Improved performance and responsiveness on mobile devices.
Made Discover and Search faster and smoother when displaying large numbers of titles.
Improved animations and transitions for a smoother browsing experience.
Improved application responsiveness when navigating between pages and content.

features.title: Better Experience
items: Improved season selection with smoother animations and better accessibility.
Improved episode loading and navigation behavior.
Improved backdrop image loading for a faster and smoother Hero experience.
Improved navigation behavior to prevent unnecessary layout shifts.
Updated the VEXORA application logo.

features.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed episode scrolling issues when navigating to specific episodes.
Fixed navigation issues when moving between History episodes.
Fixed performance issues affecting the scroll-to-top button.
Fixed rendering issues when displaying large media collections.
Improved request handling in Discover for more reliable content loading.
